_doc: The cells section (SphereCells.to_dict) of a save written before districts existed, on the level-5 test grid with hub sites on its face centres (tests/support/district_fixture.gd): every hex of the first planet's first city Sustained (stage 4), half the land of its second city cleaned, the rest untouched. It has no 'districts' and no 'restoration' key. tests/test_districts.gd loads it and expects the state to be derived.
